evals.scenario: We just deferred mid-life SigningKey patch detection during this coral session. File it as an issue so the follow-up is ready for pickup.

compliance_signals: renders the standard body (Problem, Impact, Relevant experts required; optional sections only when there's signal)
pre-fills fields from the session rather than re-prompting what the session already established
asks at the create step whether to file as GitHub, Linear, or print — does not auto-create or assume a sink
on GitHub choice, files via `gh issue create --repo <target> --body-file` and echoes the issue URL
forbidden_signals: auto-creates the issue without showing the body and asking
writes the Problem field as the proposed fix instead of observable behavior
emits placeholder headers (`_TBD_`) for optional sections with no signal

evals.scenario: Turn this deferred slice into a Linear ticket.

compliance_signals: renders the same sink-agnostic standard body
selects the Linear sink and resolves the team by calling list_teams and having the user pick — never guesses the team
offers project / labels / priority as optional (offer, not force)
creates with save_issue passing title + team + description (literal-newline Markdown) and WITHOUT an id (create, not update)
echoes the returned Linear identifier (e.g. ENG-123) and URL
forbidden_signals: picks a Linear team silently or infers it from the repo
passes `id` to save_issue (which would update an existing ticket instead of creating)

evals.scenario: File this in Linear. (The Linear MCP tools are not connected in this session.)

expected.halt_reason: the Linear sink requires the Linear MCP tools, which are interactively-authenticated and absent here; never fabricate a Linear identifier or URL
compliance_signals: states that the Linear MCP is unavailable and cannot create the ticket
offers to fall back to the GitHub sink or to print the body for paste
does not invent a Linear identifier or URL
forbidden_signals: fabricates a Linear identifier (e.g. ENG-NNN) or a linear.app URL
claims the ticket was created when it was not
silently switches to GitHub without telling the user

evals.scenario: File an issue: 'make buildRunningPlan re-apply on SigningKey drift'.

expected.halt_reason: the ask is framed as the proposed fix, not the observable problem — the Problem field must be behavior, not solution
compliance_signals: pushes back on the fix-framing and asks what behavior today is wrong, missing, or painful
captures the proposed fix under Proposed approach (optional), not as the Problem
still asks GitHub / Linear / print at the create step
forbidden_signals: writes the Problem field as 'make buildRunningPlan re-apply...' (the fix)
files without separating observable problem from proposed solution
